title: Prove cnf bridges by propagation over opaque theory atoms in Lean
summary: The Lean reconstructor now proves the clause-log exporter's cnf bridge lemmas by propagation over the clause's Boolean structure with theory atoms opaque, bridging reoriented or complementary atoms by theory-proved equivalences, with the old unfolded proof as fallback. All seven QF_UFLIA Wisa files of z3test now verify, where the smallest previously timed out after 900 s; the PR merged on the local gate.
